common_patterns.overview: Common Go implementation patterns and code templates that should be used when writing Go code. These patterns represent idiomatic Go solutions to common problems.

pattern.name: constructor
pattern.description: Create constructors with NewX() naming convention. Accept interfaces, return concrete structs.

pattern.name: interface_implementation_check
pattern.description: Add compile-time check to ensure types implement interfaces.

pattern.name: method_chaining
pattern.description: Use method chaining for fluent APIs, especially for builders.

pattern.name: error_wrapping
pattern.description: Wrap errors with context using fmt.Errorf with %w verb.

pattern.name: sentinel_errors
pattern.description: Define sentinel errors for expected error conditions.

pattern.name: custom_error_types
pattern.description: Create custom error types for domain-specific errors.

pattern.name: worker_pool
pattern.description: Implement a worker pool for controlled concurrency.

pattern.name: rate_limiter
pattern.description: Implement a rate limiter using channels.

pattern.name: http_handler
pattern.description: Implement HTTP handlers with proper error handling and JSON responses.

pattern.name: mock_interface
pattern.description: Create a mock implementation for testing.
